correctness.rationale: Expanding (x+a)^3−x^3 gives a quadratic exponential sum with coefficients 3a and 3a²−b. Grouping by v_p(3a), followed by the bijection (x,y)→(x−y,x+y) for odd p, gives an iff zero criterion and nonzero magnitude p^{(k+w)/2}; when w=k only the zero linear frequency survives. For p≥5 translation stratum t has b divisible by p^t and multiplicity (p−1)p^{2(k−t)−1}. For p=3 the criterion is b divisible by 3^{t+1} for t≤k−2, with the three terminal translations supported at b=0. Summation proves the exact R_{p,k}, including k=1. Orthogonality of N^{-1/2} Weyl operators diagonalizes the complex matrix lift with singular values sqrt(N)|A_g|, properly accounting for the unnormalized chirp. Independent direct DFT checks at (3,1),(3,2),(3,3),(5,1),(5,2),(7,1) confirmed ranks and each modulus to 1e−13. The standard lifting identity is prior, not claimed new; nonlinear phase retrieval is not inferred.
